units.source_text: 你妈妈曾有遗言，要你照顾我。

en.t: Your mother left a dying wish, asking you to look after me.

units.source_text: 我虽如此困顿，总以为你会一直跟着我的。

en.t: Though I am in such distress, I always thought you would stay with me.

units.source_text: 你今舍我而去，也是理之当然。

en.t: Now that you are leaving me behind, it is only natural and reasonable.

units.source_text: 但是你去之后，谁能代你伴我？

en.t: But after you are gone, who can take your place and keep me company?
How could I possibly keep from being heartbroken?"

units.source_text: 说到这里，哭得更悲戚了。

en.t: At this point, she wept even more sorrowfully.

units.source_text: 侍从也已泣不成声，勉强答道：“就别提妈妈的遗嘱了。

en.t: The attendant too was already sobbing so hard she could hardly speak, and forced herself to answer, "Please do not mention my mother's last wishes anymore.

units.source_text: 多年以来，我与小姐共尝千辛万苦，相依为命。

en.t: For many years, my lady and I have shared every hardship and depended on each other for survival.

units.source_text: 如今蓦地要我上道，流浪远方，真教我……”

en.t: Now, to be suddenly sent on the road to wander in distant places, it truly makes me..."
